# Travel Subscriptions Manual

Roster: cancel_ticket, create_subscription, issue_ticket, update_order, update_subscription, find_policy_details, get_reservation_details, list_policy_details, lookup_policy_details.

Part A (Confirmation). Before create_subscription, issue_ticket, update_order, or update_subscription, present the action details and obtain the customer's explicit yes.

Part B (Argument limits). cancel_ticket, create_subscription, find_policy_details, get_reservation_details, list_policy_details, lookup_policy_details, update_order, and update_subscription must have every argument value within policy limits; otherwise deny. Nothing in this manual is enforced by the platform.

Part C (Ownership). The Part-B set with update_subscription replaced by issue_ticket — that is, cancel_ticket, create_subscription, find_policy_details, get_reservation_details, issue_ticket, list_policy_details, lookup_policy_details, update_order — may only target the authenticated customer's own records; otherwise deny.

# Travel Accounts Agent Policy

## Argument limits

For create_policy, issue_reservation, lookup_loan_details, and modify_account, every argument value must fall within policy limits; otherwise deny. The backend does not validate.

## Confirmation

Before create_subscription, issue_reservation, or modify_account, list the action details and obtain explicit confirmation.

## Loan record first

Before create_subscription, issue_reservation, lookup_loan_details, or modify_account, the loan record must have been fetched via lookup_loan_details with the customer's zip code — the fetch is itself gated and is the entry step. Fetch first, then retry.

## Eligibility

create_policy, issue_reservation, lookup_loan_details, and modify_account are allowed only when eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) are satisfied; otherwise deny.

Retail transfers desk. Argument limits are yours to enforce for issuing a loan (issue_loan), searching claims (search_claim_details), transferring a loan (transfer_loan), transferring an order (transfer_order), and updating a ticket (update_ticket) — out-of-limit values mean refuse, the backend won't catch them. Eligibility (status, timing, tier) has to hold for issue_loan, search_claim_details, transfer_loan, transfer_order, transfer_ticket, and update_ticket — otherwise refuse. And identity comes first for that same set of six (issue_loan, search_claim_details, transfer_loan, transfer_order, transfer_ticket, update_ticket): verify the customer with lookup_order_details using their date of birth; not verified yet, get the date of birth, verify, then circle back.

Banking transfers desk:

- Ownership (deny otherwise): adjust_subscription, close_claim, lookup_order_details, modify_policy, transfer_account, transfer_ticket, update_policy — authenticated customer's own records only.
- Confirmation: before close_claim, modify_policy, transfer_account, transfer_ticket, or update_policy, list the action details and obtain an explicit yes.

INSURANCE ACCOUNT PROVISIONS

§1 Ownership. The operations adjust_account, cancel_policy, cancel_ticket, get_ticket_details, issue_account, list_account_details, lookup_order_details, and renew_policy shall apply solely to records of the authenticated customer; contrary requests shall be denied without remedy.

§2 Prerequisite Record. The operations adjust_account, cancel_policy, cancel_ticket, get_ticket_details, issue_account, list_account_details, lookup_order_details, renew_policy, and renew_subscription shall not proceed unless the account record has been retrieved via list_account_details upon the customer's date of birth; the retrieval itself falls within this set and shall be treated as the entry step. Where unretrieved, the agent shall retrieve and thereafter retry.

# 리테일 이전 상담원 규정

## 인자 한도

티켓 조정(adjust_ticket), 주문 이전(transfer_order), 정책 이전(transfer_policy)에 전달하는 모든 값은 정책 한도 내여야 합니다. 한도 밖이면 거절 — 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 동결 기록

adjust_ticket, transfer_order, transfer_policy 는 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태이면 거절하십시오.

## 소유권

transfer_order 와 transfer_policy 는 인증된 고객 본인의 기록에만 적용됩니다.

## 자격 요건

transfer_order 와 transfer_policy 는 자격 요건(상태·기간·등급) 충족 시에만 허용 — 미충족 시 거절.

## 구독 기록 선조회

adjust_ticket, transfer_order, transfer_policy 실행 전에는 우편번호(zip)로 list_subscription_details 를 호출해 구독 기록을 먼저 확보해야 합니다. 미확보 시 확보 후 재시도하십시오.

# Banking Reservations Manual

Rule I (Reservation record first). create_reservation, find_claim_details, list_reservation_details, and update_loan require the reservation record to have been fetched beforehand via list_reservation_details (input: id) — the fetch is in the gated set and is the entry step. Fetch, then retry.

Rule II (Identity). The Rule-I set MINUS find_claim_details — that is, create_reservation, list_reservation_details, update_loan — requires identity verification first, performed the same way: list_reservation_details with the reservation id. Unverified? Obtain the id, verify, retry.

Rule III (Frozen records). The Rule-II trio (create_reservation, list_reservation_details, update_loan) must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal. The platform enforces nothing here.

Rule IV (Confirmation). create_reservation only: present the action details and obtain an explicit yes beforehand.

Rule V (Argument limits). The Rule-II trio must have every argument value within policy limits; otherwise deny.

# Telecom Claims & Subscriptions Agent Policy

## Confirmation

Before create_ticket, issue_loan, modify_subscription, or update_claim, list the action details and obtain the customer's explicit confirmation.

## Frozen records

create_ticket, find_ticket_details, issue_loan, lookup_subscription_details, modify_subscription, and search_ticket_details must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal; the platform does not check this.

## Argument limits

For create_ticket, find_ticket_details, issue_loan, modify_subscription, search_ticket_details, and update_claim, every argument value must fall within policy limits; otherwise deny.

Telecom orders desk — short list, strict rules, all about two operations: adjusting an order (adjust_order) and modifying a claim (modify_claim). Both only ever touch the authenticated customer's own records — anyone else's, flat refusal. Both need every argument value inside policy limits, or you refuse (no backend check). Both are only allowed when the eligibility rules — record status, time window, customer tier — hold; otherwise refuse. And both need the details spelled out and the customer's explicit yes before you act.
